title: WWJD What Would Jesus Do? The Journey Continues
description: A pastor tries to lead his ex-con brother to Christ as they renovate an old church. When the church is robbed at gunpoint, one of the brothers makes a sacrifice that leads the pastor, gunman and community to redemption.

title: Til Ex Do Us Part
description: A woman is accused of arranging an attack on a woman who slept with her boyfriend during a break.

title: A Lethal Lesson
description: High school teacher Lauren stands to lose her career, and custody of her daughter, after a vengeful student turns her life upside down by falsely claiming he had an affair with her.

title: Amber's Story
description: When a young girl is kidnapped in Arlington, Texas, her family and the local community set out to find her. Based on the real-life case of Amber Hagerman, whose abduction was instrumental in the creation of America's AMBER Alert system to help find missing children.

title: WWJD II: The Woodcarver
description: Matthew Stevenson has trouble accepting his parent's divorce and vents his anger by vandalizing a church. An old and godly widower takes Matthew under his wing to repair the damage, and helps him find faith.

title: Deadly Exchange
description: Blake becomes good friends with foreign exchange student Chloe, even moving in together. However, when Blake's boyfriend is killed, and she must prove her innocence, Blake begins to realise Chloe's real plan.
